items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Tallulah Bankhead used to come up there a lot.

ctx.x: What about some of the vocalists like Billy Daniels and Della Reese and people like that?

Billy Daniels was working at one of the spots, (Inaudible), in Harlem during '34 when I first hit New York. It was Dicky Wells'. That's the spot. Tallulah Bankhead used to come up there a lot. There was, oh, you know, a lot of movie stars were downtown. He was working there and I was at the Ubanqi Club which was not too far from Dicky Wells'. Billy was singing there. He comes to the Concorde up here and tells his story on the stage a lot. So, somebody down there said the band, the 'Bama State Collegians with…

first time they had a waltz sung in the Apollo Theater cause that was a jumping theater there. So, he went over very big. And Billy was with me for about, maybe about 2 years, with me as my band singer.
